reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §14.1 vests Customer Data, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP in Customer with only a limited processing right to Vendor (no assignment).

§14.2 gives Customer ownership of Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment, personnel assignments and further-assurance; §14.3 limits Vendor retention to Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence including modification and derivative works — the preferred position.
§14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves Customer's feedback rights, so no walk-away trigger exists.
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms no residual assignment of Customer IP/data to Vendor.
The residual points (payment-conditioned assignment; 'improve the Services' in the processing right, mitigated by §15.1) are properly noted in the rationale rather than raised as deviations.
